unit: Fermat rational image arithmetic; design of the next Belyi layer
runtime_import_policy: Mathlib and independent AbcAdaptation definitions only
fixed_height: canonicalHeight p = ((N : Real) - 3) * (Height.logHeight ![u p, v p, 1] / degree p)

reference_identity.reason: refer/iut has no own .git; a parent-worktree rev-parse is not a reference commit

closed_candidate_declarations.name: RationalExpression.imagePoint_fieldOf_le
closed_candidate_declarations.full_type: forall {N : Nat} (phi : RationalExpression) (p : Fermat.Pt N) (hp : phi.Admissible p), Tripod.fieldOf (phi.imagePoint p hp).val <= Fermat.fieldOf p

closed_candidate_declarations.name: RationalExpression.imagePoint_degree_le
closed_candidate_declarations.full_type: forall {N : Nat} (phi : RationalExpression) (p : Fermat.Pt N) (hp : phi.Admissible p), Tripod.deg (phi.imagePoint p hp).val <= Fermat.degree p
closed_candidate_declarations.consumer: future compactly bounded Belyi-image node, preserving the original degree bound d

closed_candidate_declarations.name: exists_extend_embedding
closed_candidate_declarations.full_type: forall {F1 F2 : IntermediateField Rat Qbar} (h : F1 <= F2) {E : Type} [Field E] [IsAlgClosed E] (tau : F1 ->+* E), exists tau' : F2 ->+* E, forall a : F1, tau' (IntermediateField.inclusion h a) = tau a

closed_candidate_declarations.name: RationalExpression.imagePoint_conjugateBounds
closed_candidate_declarations.full_type: forall {N : Nat} (phi : RationalExpression) (p : Fermat.Pt N) (hp : phi.Admissible p) {E : Type} [NormedField E] [IsAlgClosed E] {c : Real}, phi.ConjugateBounds p E c -> forall tau : Tripod.fieldOf (phi.imagePoint p hp).val ->+* E, abs (Real.log (norm (tau (Tripod.gen (phi.imagePoint p hp).val)))) <= c and abs (Real.log (norm (tau (Tripod.gen (phi.imagePoint p hp).val) - 1))) <= c
closed_candidate_declarations.consumer: future compactly bounded Belyi-image node, after local bounds on the full Fermat point field

required_foundation_ports.required_concrete_carrier: The smooth proper normalization of U^N+V^N=W^N over Rat, N>3; a fixed function field of Rat[U,V]/(U^N+V^N-1), not an arbitrary Curve parameter
source: Belyi.CurveField.IsCurveField and Place/QbarPoint actual import closures
required_results: coordinate ring is a geometrically integral domain
the proper Fermat curve is smooth for N>0 in characteristic zero
affine QbarPoint identity with the existing Fermat.Pt N
bounded discrepancy of true canonical divisor height from the fixed canonicalHeight

required_foundation_ports.required_concrete_carrier: Heights' normed algebraic closure PadicAlgCl p of Q_p, with its algebraically closed normed-field structure; Mathlib-only workspace currently has no matching PadicAlgCl module

Actual divisors on the fixed proper Fermat function field; cuspDivisor(phi); Weil divHeight(E); coordinate-ring generator conductor logCondOf(G). No supplied Pt->Real height or conductor field is permitted

planned_precise_geometric_nodes.intended_type: forall (N : Nat), 3 < N -> forall T : Finset (Place (ProperFermat.functionField N)), exists phi : ProperFermat.functionField N, IsBelyi phi and forall P in T, P notin belyiCusps phi
planned_precise_geometric_nodes.fidelity_requirement: IsBelyi must be the genuine transcendence/ramification condition on all proper places, including infinity; no affine Jacobian-only surrogate

planned_precise_geometric_nodes.intended_type: forall N d (xs : Nat -> Fermat.Pt N), (forall n, degree (xs n) <= d) -> exists (s : Nat -> Nat), StrictMono s and exists T : Finset (Place (ProperFermat.functionField N)), forall phi, phi != 0 -> phi != 1 -> (forall P in T, phi and inverse(phi) and inverse(phi-1) are regular at P) -> exists C : Real, eventually n, phi is evaluable at xs(s n), its value is not 0 or 1, and all its images under embeddings of fieldOf(xs(s n)) into PadicAlgCl 2 and Complex satisfy both absolute-log bounds with C
planned_precise_geometric_nodes.fidelity_requirement: Must include all conjugate embeddings, not a selected embedding; the proper compactification is needed because u or v may diverge

planned_precise_geometric_nodes.intended_output: A StrictMono subsequence, a genuine Belyi phi, its concrete RationalExpression representative, a valuation-bounded Tripod.CompactlyBounded K, an eventual Admissible proof for the selected points, membership of every selected imagePoint in K.set, and imagePoint degree <= d

planned_precise_geometric_nodes.intended_type: forall N>3 and genuine Belyi phi on the fixed proper Fermat curve, exists C : Real, forall p in the admissible affine open, abs (canonicalHeight p + divHeight (cuspDivisor phi) p - Tripod.htCan (imagePoint phi p)) <= C
planned_precise_geometric_nodes.fidelity_requirement: Must consume the fixed-height/canonical-divisor identification from proper_fermat_model; hE is the genuine divHeight(cuspDivisor phi), never an arbitrary function or the definition imageHeight-canonicalHeight

planned_precise_geometric_nodes.intended_type: forall N>3, genuine Belyi phi, and q : Real, (cuspDivisor phi).degree / (N*(N-3) : Real) < q -> exists C : Real, forall p, divHeight (cuspDivisor phi) p <= q * canonicalHeight p + C
planned_precise_geometric_nodes.fidelity_requirement: Strict inequality is essential; equality at the degree ratio is not permitted. q positivity follows from effectiveness of the true cusp divisor and degree(K)>0

planned_precise_geometric_nodes.intended_type: For the actual coordinate-ring generator model G_E of the complement of E=cuspDivisor(phi), there exist constants C1,C2 independent of p such that Tripod.logDiff(imagePoint p)+Tripod.logCond(imagePoint p) <= Fermat.logDiff p + logCondOf G_E p + C1, and logCondOf G_E p <= divHeight E p + C2
planned_precise_geometric_nodes.fidelity_requirement: Normalize every discriminant and conductor by its actual point-field degree and use the concrete inclusion from imagePoint_fieldOf_le

parent_status.reason: A truthful Belyi/cusp/strict-q layer needs the fixed proper curve and genuine divisor/height carriers; this unit provides only their concrete pointwise arithmetic edges
parent_status.recommended_next_unit: Port the fixed proper Fermat function-field/Place/QbarPoint and affine identification, then freeze and compile genuine Belyi/cusp types before introducing new open geometric nodes

integration_status: Next-unit design evidence only. Not a compiled or published decomposition.
